file_semantics: Independent test owner writes private fixed file matching current published assignment; Broker must actually read its bytes under current authorization and return raw-byte sha256.
owned_installation_kind: fixture-single-role-stdio-only; distinct from prior owned fixture/official production kinds

assignment.publish.rule: Initial current owner may publish; next revision requires actual paused+fenced predecessor; do not clear pause.

assignment.revoke.rule: Only paused current owner; actual Store fence before next publish.

role.dispatch-current.rule: Single consume per session/revision; no second turn/start after completed same revision.

role.readback-current.pending: action hold while actual native callback completion/readback pending; no new turn/start
role.readback-current.completed_resume: New epoch may readonly read same completed revision/turn; do not redispatch.

runtime_commands: Prior owned-runtime contract retained; owner/pause/current epoch enforced.
pause_restart: Independent control-Broker process stop/restart with same private state. Before explicit pause(false), no child start/read/resume/dispatch/turn/start. Registered but never-dispatched thread must resume without inventing stable first-action evidence.
normal_restart: Same Broker runtime.stop then runtime.start, fresh child/epoch, actual thread/resume same stored thread id.
storage: Actual existing Store owner/tasks/turns/role_registration/native_dispatch/native_tool_operations; fixture RoleStore creates only missing scratch role tables, no ResumeStore/migration, no parallel task ledger.
native_fixture_projection: Fixture child persists only native thread/turn IDs/result projection, no owner/revision authorization; all Broker permissions/storage remain in actual product tables.
